Trace, implement and test: Cube

Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

Original source context
public class Cube extends Shape implements Spatial {
    private double length;
    private double width;
    private double height;

    public double getLength() {
        return length;
    }

    public void setLength(double length) {
        this.length = length;
    }

    public double getWidth() {
        return width;
    }

    public void setWidth(double width) {
        this.width = width;
    }

    public double getHeight() {
        return height;
    }

    public void setHeight(double height) {
        this.height = height;
    }

    @Override
    public double area() {
        return 2 * (length * width + length * height + height * width);
    }

    @Override
    public double volume() {
        return height * width * length;
    }
}
